BiblicalUsage: Sismai is a descendant of Jerahmeel in Judah's line, named once in the genealogy. His father is Eleasah and his son is Shallum, and the chain runs through him. Nothing more is told of his life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sismai is remembered because the chain of Judah matters, and every link in it is held by God.
